findings.title: Sibling getSubGroupsStream methods still NPE on concurrent delete
findings.body: The PR fixes NPE in getSubGroupsCount() by null-checking modelSupplier.get(), but the three overloads getSubGroupsStream(search,first,max), getSubGroupsStream(first,max) and getSubGroupsStream(search,exact,first,max) still do modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null check. If the group is deleted concurrently before the lazy supplier is first loaded, get() returns null and these methods throw NullPointerException, causing the same 500 failure the PR claims to fix. They need the same null handling as getSubGroupsCount().

findings.title: Concurrent test never joins reader thread, assertion is racy
findings.body: The test starts a background thread that loops while(!deletedAll.get()) calling the admin API, then deletes groups, sets deletedAll to true, and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty without joining the thread. The assert can run while the reader is still in-flight, so a failure occurring after the assert is missed (false pass) and the thread can leak into the next test. If the delete loop throws, deletedAll is never set and the thread spins forever. The tight loop with no pause/backoff also floods the server with Integer.MAX_VALUE queries.
